title: Scott's Pick: My Alaskan Partners
description:
Introducing Scott - Introducing Us! 
Time to introduce Scott, our resident CGTN Doc enthusiast, who’s  handpicked an especially choice CGTN offering - the tale of a team of Chinese adventurers participating in Alaska's Iditarod Trail Sled Dog Race! Do they have what it takes to brave the sub-zero temperatures and to navigate their dog-team across the frozen wastes of northernmost North America in just 10 days?  Join Scott to find out!

Click the link to subscribe to the CGTN Documentary channel if you like our videos: https://bit.ly/3gZVP2Y
